text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 502s + logging backlog detected. Paging sanjay (oncall).
sanjay (oncall): I'm awake, grabbing context. Which regions?
tom (support): EU and APAC customers reporting increased 502s and delayed error logs in Datadog. Support tickets coming in.
lara (sre): Confirming DD ingest shows large backlog and traces delayed ~20-40m. Our internal prometheus & k8s metrics are normal.
sanjay (oncall): good signal separation. Treat as "observability degradation" affecting alerts. Can someone post the Datadog incident link?
datadog-status-bot: https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/4721 — "Ingestion delays impacting logs and traces in some regions." engineers investigating.
alex (infra): Noted. I'm throttling non-critical DD log shipment and enabling high-priority pipeline to our backup indexer.
tom (support): drafting a customer note: short + no panic. "We're seeing delayed observability ingestion to Datadog; services continue to operate. We're using backup telemetry; we'll update shortly." Anyone want to review?
lara (sre): go ahead and send that. Also: we should flip critical alerts to prometheus and cloudwatch immediately. I'll push a small runbook entry to #inc-docs.
sanjay (oncall): Action items: 1) tom send customer note 2) lara switch alerts to prometheus 3) alex disable noisy dd feeds and start S3 sink for critical auth logs 4) I will monitor support ticket volume and escalate to L2 if >10 open. Who owns 3?
alex (infra): I'll take S3 sink + lambda that indexes into our internal search. ETA 10m.
lara (sre): switching alert rules now. Patch: set prod-api-error-rate rule to use prom_histogram:error_count over last 5m.
sanjay (oncall): commands I'm running: ```
# check datadog ingest health
http GET https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/4721
# quick prometheus check
kubectl -n monitoring get prometheusrules | grep prod-api
```
tom (support): sent customer batch at 07:45 UTC. Kept it brief.
lara (sre): Prom alerts firing for the window. We have visibility back on error-rate. Turning down dd alert noise now.
alex (infra): S3 sink is live for prod-auth and prod-billing. Pushed a small indexing job.
sanjay (oncall): initial verdict: real user errors confirmed via backup logs; some customers saw timeouts that correlate with timestamps 07:40-07:48. Classify as "partial degradation" for affected tenants.
tom (support): customers asking for root cause — any guidance?
lara (sre): cause is Datadog ingestion backlog — their pipelines delayed log and trace arrival. Our services didn't crash but some error handling induced retries/timeouts. We'll note that in the post-incident doc.
sanjay (oncall): I'm creating a ticket for postmortem. Handoff in 15m to lara. Checklist in this thread: - keep Prometheus alerts as primary until DD fully backfilled - confirm backfill for last 60m - notify customers with final timeline - open postmortem if customer impact >30m or >2% users
lara (sre): acknowledged. I'll monitor backfill and call out if we see missing spans after ingestion finishes.
alex (infra): Datadog support replied to our ticket DD-9921: "backlog being processed, no ETA yet, we'll notify when backlog clears."
datadog-status-bot: https://help.datadoghq.com/ticket/DD-9921 — ticket created.
tom (support): updating customers with status. one enterprise asked for logs — sending S3 links where available.
lara (sre): 15m update: ingestion slowly recovering; traces appearing but out-of-order for ~30m window. Prometheus continues to show error spikes matching S3 logs.
sanjay (oncall): escalated to pagerduty-bot policy if >15 open incidents. pagerduty-bot: escalation queued.
tom (support): feedback from customer — they prefer a short technical summary. I'll coordinate with lara for wording.
lara (sre): drafting technical summary: "Datadog ingestion pipeline experienced regional throughput issues causing delayed logs/traces. We used Prometheus/CW backups to triage and confirmed 502 spikes for a subset of requests. No data loss in our systems; Datadog is backfilling."
sanjay (oncall): good. final checks before I handoff: confirm DD status page shows resolved AND we've validated backfill for 60m. If both true, we can revert alerting.
datadog-status-bot: update: partial recovery, backlog draining.
lara (sre): validated backfill up to 65m window. some delayed spans still trickling but main indicators present. Marking for revert in 30m.
sanjay (oncall): handing off to lara. Please post every 20m. Good work.
incident-bot: thread autosave complete.
lara (sre): 20m update: Datadog reports resolved at 08:52 UTC. Verified backfill for last 90m. Reverting Prometheus-only alerting in 30m and removing temporary S3 sinks when safe. Filing postmortem ticket now.
tom (support): sending final customer update and POC for enterprise.
lara (sre): closing this incident thread in 1h unless further reports.
